# LanaTax

> Free Solana tax calculator. Paste your wallet address, see your transaction history with charts, and export a tax-ready CSV for Koinly and CoinLedger. Runs in your browser with your own free Helius API key. No sign-up.

## Key pages
- [LanaTax](https://tax.saneapps.com): the calculator
- [Guides](https://tax.saneapps.com/guides): all guides
